summary: The date for a rent adjustment at {hotel} can come from the occupant's history even without a written lease.
realLife: New York City's 2025 hotel order compared its effective date with a year from occupancy and a year from the last adjustment, using the latest applicable date for residents without an agreement.
gates: The case record identifies the covered occupancy, absence of agreement, move-in date and last adjustment.
inGame: needs: covered occupancy, absence of agreement, move-in date and last adjustment.

turns.what: Its anniversary pushes the eligible date later.
The occupancy anniversary can determine the date.
